name: Card
statusNote: Card is new and its API is still being designed: the layout prop is missing from its docs file, the slots are fixed, and its tokens (--card-bgColor) are not yet wired in. Expect changes before it reaches alpha.
summary: A bordered, raised box summarising one item: an icon or edge-to-edge image on top, a heading and description, a metadata row, and one corner action. Choose it for grids or lists of browsable items; use a plain bordered box for arbitrary grouped content.

inputs.name: padding
inputs.description: Inner padding: 0, 8px, or 24px (16px in the compact layout).

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: default stacks header over body; compact puts the icon beside the body with tighter spacing, no icon tile and a smaller heading.

inputs.name: standalone
inputs.description: Render as a section labelled by its heading (as='section'); leave false for a card inside a list item.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: Card.Icon: an octicon, decorative unless given an aria-label.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Card.Image: an image source, drawn edge to edge across the top; alt defaults to empty (decorative). Takes precedence over icon.

inputs.name: heading
inputs.description: Card.Heading: the title, h3 by default (h2 to h6).

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Card.Description: one paragraph of muted text.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.description: Card.Metadata: a row of small muted items (text, icons, a Label) under the content.

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Card.Action: one control (an IconButton or menu) in the top-right corner, labelled with the card's name.

inputs.name: children
inputs.description: Free content, used only when no Card.* slot is given; the card then lays it out in its padded grid.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: A grid box clipping its content: 1px --borderColor-default border, --shadow-resting-small, --bgColor-default fill, radius by borderRadius, padding by padding, rows separated by --stack-gap-normal.

anatomy.name: Header
anatomy.description: Row 1: the image, pulled out to the card's edges, or the icon.

anatomy.name: Image
anatomy.description: Full width of the card, natural aspect ratio, flush with the top and side edges.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: In the default layout, a 32px --bgColor-muted tile with --borderRadius-medium corners and the icon centred in --fgColor-muted; in compact, the bare icon.

anatomy.name: Heading
anatomy.description: Small title text in --fgColor-default, no margin.

anatomy.name: Description
anatomy.description: Medium body text in --fgColor-muted, no margin, --stack-gap-condensed below the heading.

anatomy.name: Metadata
anatomy.description: A centred row of small muted items with --stack-gap-condensed between an item's icon and text.

anatomy.name: Action
anatomy.description: One control pinned 16px from the top and right edges, above the content.

variants.description: 24px on all sides; 16px in the compact layout.
Header row over body row; icon in a 32px muted tile; small title heading.
Icon beside the body, top-aligned, --stack-gap-condensed apart; no icon tile; heading at body-medium size raised 4px; normal padding becomes 16px.

layout.text: The card is a grid of auto rows (the first sized to its content), with --stack-gap-normal between header and body; it clips its children to its rounded border box.
Padding normal is --stack-padding-spacious, condensed --stack-padding-condensed, none 0; in the compact layout normal is --stack-padding-normal.
An image header extends past the padding to the card's top, left and right edges by --stack-padding-spacious on each side and is full width at its natural aspect ratio.
In the default layout the icon sits in a 32px square tile of --bgColor-muted with --borderRadius-medium corners, icon centred in --fgColor-muted.
The body stacks content then metadata --stack-gap-normal apart; inside content the heading and description are --stack-gap-condensed apart.

The metadata row centres its items vertically in --text-body-shorthand-medium and --fgColor-muted with --stack-gap-normal between items; each item is itself a row in --text-body-shorthand-small with --stack-gap-condensed between its icon and text.
The action is absolutely placed --base-size-16 from the card's top and right edges, above the content (z-index 1), whatever the padding.

In the compact layout the card is a top-aligned row with --stack-gap-condensed: the header (icon) keeps its content width and the body takes the rest; the heading drops to --text-body-size-medium and moves up --base-size-4 to align with the icon.

behaviour.text: The card itself is not interactive and has no hover or press state; only the action control and any links inside it respond.
Slot children are recognised by type and placed in a fixed order (header, heading, description, metadata, action) regardless of source order; a card with no children renders nothing.

accessibility.role: none (div) by default; region (section) when standalone, labelled by its heading
keyboard: The card is not focusable; Tab reaches the action and any links inside it.
semantics: A standalone card is a section whose aria-labelledby points at the heading, unless a label is supplied.
The icon is hidden from assistive technology unless it has an aria-label, then it is an img.
The image's alt defaults to empty, so it is decorative unless alt is given.
The action's label should name the card, since several cards show the same control.

notes.text: The edge-to-edge image always uses --stack-padding-spacious negative margins, so with condensed or none padding (or the compact layout's 16px) it overshoots the card and is cropped by the clip on both sides and the top.

Only one of each slot survives: a second Card.Metadata (or heading, description, icon, image, action) replaces the first, and an image suppresses an icon. Any non-slot child is dropped once a slot child is present; put several metadata items inside one Card.Metadata.
The action is pinned 16px from the corner and nothing reserves room for it, so a long heading runs under it; leave space in the heading or the image area.
--card-bgColor exists (aliasing --bgColor-default) but the module reads --bgColor-default directly.
Card.docs.json omits the layout prop that Card.tsx accepts (default or compact); build to the code.
The card clips its children with overflow: hidden to its rounded border box; a native build needs a rounded clip rect (or a rounded image mask) for the image header.
The image keeps its natural aspect ratio at full width (height: auto) once loaded; a native build must know the image size before layout or reserve a box and re-layout when it arrives.
